========================================================================
  LUMORA SCHOOL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM - HOW TO RUN
========================================================================

This folder runs on ANY computer that has Java. Nothing else is needed:
no MySQL, no XAMPP, no Maven, no internet. The database is built in.


------------------------------------------------------------------------
 STEP 1 - Make sure Java is installed  (one time only)
------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Open Command Prompt and type:      java -version

  If it prints a version 17 or higher, you are ready. Go to Step 2.

  If it says "not recognized", install Java first:
    1. Go to  https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?version=17
    2. Download the Windows  .msi  installer (JDK 17, x64).
    3. Run it. On the "Custom Setup" screen, turn ON
       "Add to PATH"  and  "Set JAVA_HOME".
    4. Finish, then close and reopen Command Prompt.


------------------------------------------------------------------------
 STEP 2 - Start Lumora
------------------------------------------------------------------------

  WINDOWS:  double-click        RUN-LUMORA.bat
  Mac/Linux: in a terminal run  bash RUN-LUMORA.sh

  A black window opens and prints startup messages.
  Wait ~30-40 seconds until you see:

        Started LumoraApplication

  Leave that window OPEN while you use the system.
  (Closing it stops the server.)


------------------------------------------------------------------------
 STEP 3 - Open it in your browser
------------------------------------------------------------------------

        http://localhost:8081

  Sign in with:

        Username:  principal
        Password:  Lumora@123

  Other roles (same password):
        bursar        - finance
        librarian     - library
        grace.wanjiru - class teacher
        student       - student portal
        parent        - parent portal
        superadmin    - full administration


------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SHOWING SEVERAL ROLES AT ONCE (for the presentation)
------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Each browser TAB keeps its own separate login. Open several tabs and
  sign into a different role in each - they will not affect each other.

  (This is why the address bar shows ";jsessionid=..." - it is what
   keeps each tab independent. It is intentional in this demo mode.)


------------------------------------------------------------------------
 TROUBLESHOOTING
------------------------------------------------------------------------

  "Port 8081 was already in use"
      Something else is on that port. Start on another port instead:
      open Command Prompt in this folder and run:

        java -jar lumora.jar --spring.profiles.active=standalone,demo --server.port=9090

      then open  http://localhost:9090

  "Java was not found"
      Do Step 1 above (install Java 17+ and tick "Add to PATH").

  Want to start from a completely empty school?
      Close the server and delete the  lumora-data  folder that appears
      next to lumora.jar, then start again.

  Nothing shows in the browser / spinning
      Wait for "Started LumoraApplication" in the black window first.
      First start is the slowest (~40s); later starts are faster.
========================================================================
